title: Indra's Net
summary: From the image in the Avataṃsaka Sūtra: an endless net with a jewel at every knot, each jewel reflecting all the others. Every agent holds a short reflection (one-line summary) of every other agent and passes changes to its neighbours. There is no centre, and a change anywhere ripples everywhere. The planter sets up the net, then steps back.
whenToUse: Decentralised systems where any agent may need the whole picture at any time and no coordinator should be required: offline devices, peer swarms.
strengths: Every agent can act on the whole picture
Scales by gossip: a few messages each
risks: Reflections can be out of date
Memory grows with the number of agents unless summaries stay tight
Conflicting changes need a merge rule

smileMetrics.cooperation: Changes forwarded within one round of being received.
smileMetrics.harmony: How alike the reflections are across jewels.
smileMetrics.gathering: Rounds for one change to reach every jewel.

communication: Each round every jewel gossips its changed lines to its neighbours. The planter speaks again only when the Keeper reports drift for three rounds.
cooperation: Cooperation = lines forwarded within one round ÷ lines received. Harmony = 1 minus drift.

roles.name: Net Planter
Jewel
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per jewel. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
💎✨ ***Jewel [$id$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You are jewel [$id$]. You work on [$Part$] and hold a reflection of every jewel. ) :)
(: Listen ( Reflections from your neighbours [$Neighbours$]. ) :)
[= Merge by the rule. Forward each line you changed to all neighbours, once. =]
[: Response Format (
💎✨ ***Jewel [$id$]***:
# My State
{one line: state, version, need}
# Reflection
{the merged table of all jewels}
# Forward
{lines you changed this round}
) :]

roles.name: Net Keeper
roles.prompt:
(; Write one, deterministic. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🧮💎 ***Net Keeper***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You sample reflections across the net. ) :)
(: Listen ( Random jewels each round. ) :)
[= Report differences only; change nothing. =]
[: Response Format (
🧮💎 ***Net Keeper***:
# Drift
{jewels whose reflections differ, and by how much}
) :]

message.shape: SMILE response: name tag line, then "# Section" blocks named in roles[].sections
